function.name: Actor_TerrainCollisionLoop
per_record_prelude: for the ordinary path, require actor flags +0x06 bit 0x01, nonnegative vertical velocity at +0x1A, and a nonzero frame pointer at +0x14
clear actor interaction state at +0x3D before terrain sampling

ordinary_sampling.bounds: Skip the sample when actor Y is beyond LEVEL_HEIGHT_PIXELS + 0xC8 or the resolved row pointer is outside the active work-RAM bound.
ordinary_sampling.cell: Use actor X low nibble and the row word selected from TERRAIN_ROW_POINTER_TABLE at actor Y - 0xF0; read the terrain behavior byte from TERRAIN_CONTOUR_RESOURCE and publish it to ACTOR_TERRAIN_BEHAVIOR_SCRATCH.
ordinary_sampling.neighbor_fallback: When the current behavior class is empty, sample one row above and then one row below using TERRAIN_ROW_BYTE_STRIDE. If all three classes are empty and actor flags +0x06 bit 0x80 are clear, add 0x78 to vertical velocity.
solid_response: publish the decoded resource third byte at the selected terrain index to actor +0x3D
when actor flags +0x3C bit 0x10 are clear, clear vertical velocity +0x1A

otherwise set actor horizontal-facing +0x09 from the behavior's 0x683E direction table, halve/negate vertical velocity, optionally queue event 0x50 when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set, align actor Y to the decoded terrain surface, and set actor flags +0x07 bit 0x10

flagged_path.condition: Actor flags +0x3C bit 0x08 are set, the frame pointer is nonzero, and actor Y is within LEVEL_HEIGHT_PIXELS + 0xE0.
flagged_path.sampling: Samples the current and next terrain rows; it also treats behavior-index values above 0xDF as nonempty.
flagged_path.nonempty_result: Releases actor-owned resources and runs Actor_HandleType2DInteraction, retiring/reinitializing the terrain-invalid actor through the shared Type-0x2D path.

helper_contract.0x001ADB32: Terrain_ActorCollisionNoOpHook is called after each selected row word and before the terrain behavior byte is read; it is an RTS-only instrumentation boundary.
helper_contract.0x001ABE8A: Actor_HandleType2DInteraction performs the shared actor reinitialization used by the terrain-invalid cleanup path.

evidence: Three-row terrain sampling through TERRAIN_ROW_POINTER_TABLE and TERRAIN_ROW_BYTE_STRIDE
Actor interaction-state producer finding and actor cleanup contracts
conclusion: The actor-terrain boundary is explicit: live non-player actors sample current/adjacent terrain rows, publish resource byte 2 to actor +0x3D, apply either gravity or a grounded/facing/vertical response, and set the per-record terrain-contact flag. The flagged path retires/reinitializes actors whose sampled terrain is nonempty or invalid. This service is distinct from Player_TerrainLandingResolver and does not write player coordinates or scene state directly.
